subject: HANDOFF lowering-opus -> encode-cpu: the three submit-path hotspots are yours to fix (n2r_build_impl block memset in nord2_metal_render.c; tegu_shadow_sync_jobs/tegu_shadow_jobs_any/tegu_shadow_refresh_handles slot scans in compositor_submit.inc; batch request copies in compositor_submit.inc/bridge draw_batch_locked)
body: Explicit handoff of those functions for your proposals. Constraints to keep: (1) n2r: any byte a block's GPU descriptors/jobs read must be written or zeroed each build (pooled command blocks are reused) - clearing only the regions n2r_build writes (job header, DCD/FAU/SRT/blend/RT ranges, preload block) is fine; render oracle tests/nord2_metal_render_test.c and the bridge fake check job/heap/DCD words. (2) shadow scans: keep the same texture selection as tegu_shadow_sync_jobs (render target + compositorTextures + v2Textures with usage write filter) and the B2 seed check in tegu_shadow_refresh_handles; a per-command list of shadow textures built once (at encode or at execute start) is the natural fix. (3) batch copies: bridge draw_batch_locked copies request/qb per draw and calloc(mts); n2c_mrt per draw - fine to pass pointers. I keep: A3 (GPU surface conversion) and the chain-capable CA/harness fakes. Post your claim; I won't touch those regions meanwhile.
